summary: Full frontend regression of Signal Stack visual rebuild (white/navy/cyan palette, Geist + Instrument Serif + JetBrains Mono). Validated splash flow with sessionStorage, all sections, hero, nav, mailto CTAs, apply form, legal routes, responsiveness across 390/768/1280px. All 14 feature checks PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Splash uses fixed 1900ms/2400ms timers — fine here, but consider gating onDone behind a CSS animationend for resilience on slow devices.

useReveal hook runs in Home but IntersectionObserver is created once on mount — sections lazy-rendered inside Splash overlay state can miss observation; current behaviour works because Splash overlays and sections are mounted simultaneously, but worth a guard.
Two benign React Router v7 future-flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath). Non-blocking; add future flags on BrowserRouter to silence.
App.js is ~1075 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting Nav/Hero/Problem/Scan/Build/etc. into separate component files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash flow verified: cold load shows splash (data-testid='splash-screen'), disappears in <4s, body 'noscroll' class removed. SessionStorage key 'ss_splash_done' correctly suppresses splash on reload (verified: no splash element on second nav). All 11 sections render in order. All 8 mailto CTAs point to exact 'mailto:peter@signalstack.co.uk?subject=Signal%20Stack%20Scan%20Enquiry'. hero-secondary-cta href='#apply' and scrolls to apply form. Scan 'From' label sits above £495 (fromTop < priceTop). Build 'From' above '£1,500+'. 8 deliverables, 4 build cards. Form submission via qualify-submit triggers a mailto request containing TEST%20Name / test%40example.com / Test%20role and body fields; button text flips to 'Email opened'. /privacy and /terms render client-side with correct H1s ('Privacy Policy.' / 'Terms of Service.') and 'Back to brief' link returns home. No horizontal overflow at 390/768/1280px. No 404s. Console only emits React Router future-flag warnings.
